remarks: First floor, easy living in this meticulously maintained STUDIO apartment convenient to just about everything Stamford has to offer. An open concept layout with natural light pouring in makes this the perfect place to call home. Large private storage unit and laundry in basement. Assigned parking right in front with easy access to unit plus visitor parking. Minutes to shopping, restaurants, entertainment, houses of worship, schools and more. A quick drive to downtown, walking distance to the Glenbrook train station and shopping center. Close to both Merritt Parkway and I-95. Don't miss out!
